description: This PHP source file defines the class 'DashletMetaDataParser', which extends 'ListLayoutMetaDataParser' and handles parsing, merging, and saving metadata related to dashboard dashlets in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing, merging view definitions, converting search definitions, and saving updated dashlet configurations.

classes.name: DashletMetaDataParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing, merging, and saving metadata for dashlet views, including handling search and list view definitions for SuiteCRM dashboard components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DashletMetaDataParser instance, setting view type, module, and package info, and configuring columns based on whether it's a search view.

methods.name: mergeFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Merges view definitions with field definitions, adjusting for search or dashlet view types and filtering out relate fields for search views.

methods.name: convertSearchToListDefs
methods.description: Converts search view definitions into list definitions, ensuring each element has a 'name' key.

methods.name: ConvertSearchToDashletDefs
methods.description: Adjusts search definition data for dashlet display, setting default values appropriately.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the dashlet metadata configuration to the filesystem, handling both search and list views.
